mpv 0.35.0 — macOS x86_64 binary distribution

mpv project:
https://mpv.io/
https://github.com/mpv-player/mpv

macOS binary build:
https://laboratory.stolendata.net/~djinn/mpv_osx/

The official mpv installation page lists the Stolendata macOS builds:
https://mpv.io/installation/

Archive:
https://laboratory.stolendata.net/~djinn/mpv_osx/mpv-0.35.0.tar.gz

Archive SHA-256:
376415c787aef391a3927cdecd5bb0dac9f21ef9d7742516b8cd8d8ce502e7b6

The Catalina Intel build of 240-MP copies the mpv executable and its
bundled runtime libraries from this archive into the application bundle.

The mpv files themselves are not modified by this project.
